'''T9-N9''' was a [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was owned by the [[Order of Revan|Revanite]] [[Torrun]], who resided in the [[Revanite compound]] in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="Mask" />
